cs.t: For me I actually spent a fair bit of time trying to decide what machine to get, after my iMac died. What I went with is a docked 15 inch MBP (16gb ram, 2.5ghz i7) Display's on desk are an HP 32-inch envy (main) and portrait 24 inch dell p2414 (secondary) Mouse is logitech m705, keyboard corsair mechanical keyboard dev done in virtualbox linux VM, which i definitely recommend doing if you can get away with it. I will likely move to a linux machine next time around, short of apple surprising us with a new release.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's your dev machine setup?

cs.t: I used to use a M705 mouse from Logitech. It has a three-year rated battery life on a single pair of regular AA batteries.  https://www.logitech.com/en-us/products/mice/m705-wireless-m...  This M550 mouse is rated for two years using the Bolt wireless adapter.  https://www.logitech.com/en-us/products/mice/m550-signature-...  The K400 keyboard+trackpad I have routinely lasts at least couple of years despite only rated for 18 months, but it didn't get as much usage as a regular kb+m as it was mostly used as a couch keyboard or as a quick debugging combo for working on machines on a workbench.  https://www.logitech.com/en-us/products/keyboards/k400-plus-...
